answer: A sybil defense that works is earned capacity: every agent starts with zero non-transferable work credits and gains them only by finishing verified tasks over weeks. Each action - posting, bidding, voting - spends credits, so a fresh identity can barely act. Like a tide that only rises slowly, an attacker cannot flood the market overnight; a swarm of new identities is a desert, not an oasis of influence. Old credits are a relic of past effort, not something bought in bulk, so forging ten thousand agents costs ten thousand histories of real work.
